story.title: IT'S OUR CAR
paragraphs_en: (This story is dedicated to my Dearest Vikram and all the little Children for the love of Cars.) I am going to tell a sweet story that happened a while ago. Since you like Cars, let me say, it happened during the days when Ambassador Car ruled the roads.

One fine busy morning, Baby Boy looked out of the window hearing the toot-toot noise on the street. It was something that moved, had something round, made toot-toot noise and there was someone inside. The round thing smiled when it moved. Baby Boy smiled back and clapped in excitement. Mommy saw this and asked, "What is that?" Baby Boy said,"Maa!" Baby Boy knows only one word-"Maa!" Mommy smiled and said "It's a Car - A Red CAR".

The next day Baby Boy heard the same toot-toot noise. Baby Boy sprung in joy and hurried to the window. It was the same moving thing but a different one. It smiled back at him. Baby Boy ran to his mother and said,"Maa! Maa!" He pointed out at the window. Mommy asked, "What is it?" Baby Boy knows only one word - "Maa!" Mommy smiled and said, "It's a Car - A Yellow Car".

Again,the very next day, Baby Boy peeped out of the window and waited for his new friend. The toot-toot noise making, round thing came in a different dress this time. Baby ran to his Mommy clapping,"Maa,Maa!". Mommy knows baby's excitement. She held baby's finger and followed him to the window. Baby pointed at the Car and said the one word he knows, "Maa!" Mommy smiled back at him and said,"It's a Car- A Brown Car"

﻿ That evening Mommy and Baby went out to play at the park. Baby boy saw his friend standing. Baby wanted to go near the Car, but Baby knows only one word "Maa". Mommy knows what it is. They went near the toot-toot noise making, round moving thing. She said, It's a Car- A Blue Car".

For the first time Baby Boy touched the round thing, waved his little hands to the shiny squares at the front and small squares at the back. It did not move. It was there smiling at the Baby. Mommy lifted the Baby Boy and showed inside the glass windows. There was nobody inside. Mommy pointed from outside at something round inside and said "Toot-toot". Baby was very happy on their way back home.

Next day,Daddy and Baby Boy were playing with toys. Baby Boy heard the toot-toot noise from inside.Baby Boy cheerfully clapped and pointed at the window. He said to his Daddy-"Maa!" Daddy said,"Maa will be here soon. She is going to bring fruits for the Baby Boy". Baby Boy took Baby steps towards the window,held Daddy's finger and said for the first time,"Caaa!'. Daddy heard it right.Baby Boy said."Caaa!" Daddy became happy and shared it with Mommy when she is back.Mommy was happy too. Mommy said,"Now Baby Boy knows one more word too-"CAAA!"

One fine day,Mommy took the Baby Boy outside to show a new,"CAAA!" Baby Boy was so happy that he cheered, clapped as he sat inside the new car. He laid his hands on every possible thing in the Car. He tooted on the little round thing inside the Car,sitting on his Daddy's lap. Baby Boy said to his Mommy. "Maa! Caaa!Too-Too"

Mommy said,"Yes,Dear. It's Our Car-Green Car". It was an exciting day for the Baby Boy .His Big Friend took the entire family out on a ride. Little did he know that he is going to remember those moments for years to come.
